Ch131 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: noncommutative geometry | ID: 65086

Proposition

Let X be a topological space with continuous structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. By the finite-rank spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01310011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the finite-rank spectral family.

Step 2. Applying the torsion-free interpolation theorem to \(R_{01310012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. The Lipschitz operator \(P_{01310013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01310013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Laplace interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
